what: The four corners of the auditorium screen (cinema_layout_14.json screen.corners_wall) in 1920x1080 pixels of each frame of the rendered shot, for the OBS corner pin of the film. x right, y down, (0,0) = top-left corner of the frame. Central pose of each frame (the motion blur is centred on it). Corners may lie outside the frame while the camera moves (leaves_frame_by_px > 0).
